title: 123. Design Bounded Blocking Queue
prompt: Design a thread-safe `BoundedBlockingQueue(capacity)` with blocking `enqueue(element)`, blocking `dequeue()`, and `size()`.
invariant: threading.Condition() with not_full and not_empty condition waits around deque
steps: In `enqueue(x)`: `with self.cond: while len(self.q) == self.cap: self.cond.wait(); self.q.append(x); self.cond.notify_all()`
In `dequeue()`: wait `while not self.q`, pop left, `notify_all()`, return value; `size()` returns `len(self.q)` under lock
